description:
Shenfei and Yikun had been living under the same roof for years, and ever since childhood, Shenfei has had a special feeling towards Yikun. Without realizing it, Yikun started to grow feelings towards Shenfei. This is a story of a romance between 2 loving teenagers in their last year of middle school.

[Original Movingtoon](https://page.kakao.com/content/57441621)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=2707843), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/49624127), MeToon

**Official Translations:**  
S.Chinese ([AC.QQ](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/comicInfo/id/551405), [BiliBili](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc26027), [KuaiKan](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/1075/)), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0001352)

*Notes:* KakaoPage merged with series [There's Only You in My Heart](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/9npw9po) with [Ajjil-Ajjil](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/j9n3khc).
